en.prefs.tools_window: Tools in a separate window (two screens)
en.prefs.tools_window_note: The ribbon, History and Browser move to a window of their own that you can drag to another screen. The main window keeps only the model and its dialogs.

sl.prefs.tools_window_note: Trak, Zgodovina in Brskalnik se preselijo v svoje okno, ki ga lahko povlečete na drug zaslon. Glavno okno obdrži samo model in njegova pogovorna okna.
